subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent bundled discovery loss and out-of-scope activation

question: After rebasing onto current main, should this PR adopt the single current plugin-metadata graph as the canonical lifecycle contract for provider and auth discovery?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes process-wide metadata retention and publication semantics across plugin activation and provider/auth consumers; that compatibility boundary needs maintainer ownership even though focused proof is positive.

options.title: Rebase and merge
options.body: Confirm the complete-unscoped snapshot invariant on the merge result, then accept the single-snapshot lifecycle model.

options.title: Keep multi-graph reuse
options.body: Retain the historical multi-key memo behavior if concurrent workspace-specific registry graphs are an intentional supported contract.
